protocol.beat: ScorePerformer get_bar_beat_ticks meter-aware score beat grid
protocol.beat_anchor: ScorePerformer get_performance_beats: simultaneous score onsets are collapsed to one mean performance onset; beat boundaries are exact hits or linear interpolation between adjacent onset pairs, with optional monotonic-time filtering
protocol.note_ratio: (performance onset - fitted performance beat anchor) / realized local beat duration
protocol.note_ratio_standard: (performance onset - fitted performance beat anchor) / score beat duration in milliseconds
protocol.beat_duration: time from a fitted performance beat anchor to the next anchor; score duration is the time between adjacent score beat ticks
protocol.beat_duration_ratio: performance beat duration / score beat duration
protocol.note_duration_ratio: performance note duration / score note duration
protocol.duration_distributions: score_raw and label_shared_raw duration columns, in milliseconds; log plots use natural logarithm of milliseconds
protocol.note_order: score MIDI sorted by onset,pitch,end,velocity; no pitch-selected anchor
protocol.negatives: signed values are now measurable; negative means earlier than the fitted performance beat pulse
